title: EO 14409 - Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security
authority_note: Primary official Federal Register Executive Order text (order dated June 2, 2026).
claims: EO 14409 dated June 2, 2026; promotes AI innovation and security with the private sector
Sec. 2: 30-day cyber-defense priorities (National Security Systems, DoW, civilian Federal via CISA); AI cybersecurity clearinghouse (Treasury/NSA/CISA); OPM cybersecurity hiring expansion
Sec. 3: classified benchmarking to designate 'covered frontier models'; voluntary framework giving Government up to 30 days pre-release access to covered frontier models; trusted-partner early access
Sec. 3(c): no mandatory licensing/preclearance/permitting for new AI models
Sec. 4: AG to prioritize criminal enforcement (18 U.S.C. 1028/1030/1343) against AI-enabled illegal computer access
draft_usage: Cited for the June 2026 US AI security executive order under Social (US policy).
issues: Order uses 'Secretary of War'/'Department of War' (2026 DoD rename).
